s.how: Cut 3 brown onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Dredge in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until deep golden. Mix 100g mayo with 3 tbsp barbecue sauce to dip.

Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 1 jar chopped artichoke hearts, 250g cream cheese, 100g sour cream, 50g parmesan and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Top with 100g mozzarella and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling. Serve with corn chips.

m.note: Shrek's pot bubbling in the swamp
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions, 3 garlic cloves and 2 celery sticks. Add 250ml red wine and 500ml stock, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Stir in 200g peas and 100g spinach at the end. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: in the morning, he's making waffles
w.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 400ml buttermilk, 2 yolks and 80g melted butter. Whip 2 whites to soft peaks and fold through. Cook in a hot waffle iron until crisp. Serve with whipped cream, 250g strawberries and maple syrup.

d.note: green and murky, like the swamp
d.how: Core and chop 3 green apples and 1 cucumber. Blitz with the juice of 3 limes, a big handful of mint, 2 tbsp honey and 2 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into four glasses and serve straight away with a mint sprig.
